decisions.reason: The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not change the independent USB-powered 3.3V rail behavior.
The AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power source; changing the GPIO controlling the separate 5V boost rail does not alter this requirement.
The DCDC1 3.3V output voltage, current rating, and normal-operation role remain unchanged.
The same source assigns SPI MOSI to GPIO26, which is currently assigned to touch wake, but it does not specify whether the touch-wake pin must change or whether the assignments can coexist.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not affect the battery connector type, contacts, accessibility, or unresolved physical pin order.
Battery cutoff and thermal-protection behavior are unaffected by the 5V rail enable-pin reassignment.
The charge-status LED circuitry and GPIO13 indication path remain unchanged.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing its 5V-rail shutdown control from GPIO3 to GPIO5.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording 5V_EN on GPIO5 and the stated SCL0 and SPI MOSI remappings.
The interboard connector continues to carry the logical 5V_EN signal on pin 7; only its MCU GPIO endpoint changes.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector placement constraints.
The interboard power connector and its rail-matching rule are unaffected by reassignment of the separate 5V_EN control signal.
